comment: The Case Board at CHAPTER'S END: all six things found, every lead pulled, Wick crossed off by the strongbox counterfoil (suspects gain a cleared strike, 2026-08-09). Exists so the finished board -- full grid, three face-up suspects, the ClearedStrike over Wick -- can be reviewed and photographed without playing the whole chapter: `godot --path game -- --tour --tour-out <dir> --scene scenario:case_board_end`.
